rules.statement: Every flip-flop of the block shall be clocked by the rising edge of i_clk.
o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready, o_s_axi_arready, o_s_axi_bvalid and o_s_axi_rvalid shall be 0.
o_s_axi_bresp, o_s_axi_rresp and o_s_axi_rdata shall be 0.
Every bit of o_regs shall be 0.
Every output shall take its reset value asynchronously, without waiting for a rising edge of i_clk.

rules.condition: At a clock edge where i_rst_n is 0
rules.statement: No transfer shall happen on any channel, whatever the values of the valid and ready inputs.

rules.condition: At edge R1, the first rising edge after reset release
rules.statement: No transfer shall happen on any channel at R1, because the ready outputs and bvalid/rvalid are 0 in the cycle ending at R1.

rules.condition: From edge R1, in the cycle starting at R1
rules.statement: o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready and o_s_axi_arready shall be 1.

rules.condition: After R1, until a write or read transaction makes them 1
When i_rst_n is asserted while a write address, write data, write response or read address is held or pending
rules.statement: The held state shall be discarded.

rules.condition: After release, for a transaction pending when reset was asserted
rules.statement: No B or R response shall be given for that transaction, and no register shall be written by it.

rules.condition: A valid held at 1 through reset and after R1
rules.statement: It shall be treated as a new transfer request, taken at the first edge after R1 where the matching ready is 1.
